<!-- Contribution guide / 贡献指南: https://github.com/zhenglimindesign-ing/reflection-companion/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -->

## Problem and change / 问题与改动

Related Issue / 关联 Issue:

Explain the problem and resulting behavior or wording. / 说明问题和修改后的行为或表述。

## Evidence and checks / 证据与检查

- Skill version and host, if relevant / 相关的 Skill 版本与宿主:
- Checks actually performed and results / 实际做过的检查及结果:
- Remaining gaps; translation help needed / 剩余缺口及需要的翻译协助:

For behavior changes, include fictional input, expected behavior, before / after output, and relevant correction or insufficient-material cases. Documentation-only fixes can use a focused diff and link review.

行为改动请附虚构输入、预期、前后输出，以及相关的纠正或材料不足案例。纯文档纠错可以核对改动和链接。

## Before submitting / 提交前

- [ ] Public material contains no private chats, diaries, credentials, or identifiable third-party information. / 公开材料没有私人聊天、日记、凭据或可识别的第三方信息。
- [ ] Checks and missing evidence are reported accurately. / 如实说明已做检查和证据缺口。
- [ ] Generated inventories, checksums, and release versions are left to the maintainer. / 生成清单、校验和及发布版本留给维护者处理。

The maintainer transfers accepted edits to the development source with contribution credit, then regenerates the official distribution. Candidate edits may fail the original release hash check; do not update hashes by hand.

维护者把采纳的改动和贡献记录回收到开发源，再生成官方发行版。候选改动可能无法通过原发行哈希检查，请勿手改哈希。
